match.reason: The bank points teach the definitions of training and development and induction, not how promotion and training investment motivate staff, so none teaches the same idea as this point.

draft.title: Career advancement and training
card: the chance to move up to a higher role with more responsibility, and usually more pay. It shows staff that effort can lead to a future in the business.
the business pays for staff to build skills, through courses, mentoring or time on the job. Staff become better at their work and more able to take on new tasks.
Both can motivate because staff see that the business is investing in them. A person who sees a path ahead has a reason to stay and to work well.
Promotion works only if staff believe it is open to them. If senior roles always go to outsiders, the chance to advance may not motivate anyone.
draft.remember: Showing staff a path to a better role, and building their skills, gives them reasons to work well and stay.

a.q: Why can a business paying for staff to complete training courses motivate those staff?
opts: It builds their skills and shows it sees a future for them
It gives them a bonus that rises with each sale they make
It removes the need for them to receive any feedback at work
It lets managers punish staff who do not finish the courses
a.why: Training builds skills and signals that the business sees a future for the staff member. A bonus linked to sales is a different method, based on paying for results. Training does not replace feedback and is not a form of punishment.
a.clue: Think about what the business is showing the worker by spending money on them.

b.q: Priya manages a bakery in Geelong. She wants staff to see a future at the bakery. Which action fits this aim best?
opts: Fund a trainee's cake course, then offer a senior baker role
Pay each baker a bonus for the most loaves sold each week
Ask bakers to work flexible hours around their family needs
Send a written warning to any baker who arrives late
b.why: A course followed by a path to a senior role builds skills and shows a future in the business. A bonus for loaves sold rewards results instead. Flexible hours and warnings are about support and sanctions, which are not the aim here.
b.clue: Look for the option that builds skills and points to a higher role.

a.best: It builds their skills and shows it sees a future for them

b.best: Fund a trainee's cake course, then offer a senior baker role
